name: project-cleanup
description: Codex plugin for clean project handoffs and new-thread continuity.

interface.shortDescription: Clean handoffs for long Codex chats.
interface.longDescription: ProjectCleanup prepares concise project handoffs, creates lightweight init prompts for new Codex threads, and preserves current-project boundaries so long chats can continue with less token load.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a clean handoff for this project chat.
